what: Wf-A108b budget arms: (B1) the vector-channel head trained 5 epochs at lr 1e-3 instead of 1e-4, and (L) a 32-cloud liveness probe that asks whether the velocity field moves at all under the trainer's full objective.

findings.field_is_live: RMS |delta| 1.6e-3 over 3 epochs = 75 steps at lr 1e-3, i.e. 2.1% of the 75*lr = 0.075 upper bound on coherent Adam displacement. The field is in the gradient path (not inert), but its update is close to sign-noise.
findings.lr_is_not_the_lever: At 10x the tuned lr the FM term moves 12.1608 -> 12.1200 over 5 epochs (0.34%), while bond_ce falls 0.9988 -> 0.3642.
findings.batch_snr_is_the_suspect: 200 clouds at batch 8 = 25 steps/epoch; the capacity gate fit ONE fixed 8-cloud batch at ONE t, which is the opposite regime. The remaining untested lever is corpus/batch size (c7: 26,715 clouds, batch 64), not lr and not epochs.

honest_limits: One seed per arm. The epoch-to-epoch spread of fm_term (12.12-12.37) is larger than the 5-epoch drift (0.04), so B1 cannot exclude a slow trend.
fm_term is an epoch MEAN over ~25 batches with t ~ U(0,1) per cloud; it is not comparable in absolute value to the capacity gate's single-batch t=0.5 MSE.
The liveness probe ran on 32 clouds, not 200, so its per-step gradient SNR is not the training run's.
B2 (20 epochs at lr 1e-4) was authored (configs/wfa108b_budget20_vector_channels.yaml) and NOT run: B1 at 10x the lr is already flat, and lr x steps says B2 closes only 1/8 of the gate's gap.
